evidence_sentence: Clinical trials with [[TGT:sodium-glucose cotransporter 2]] (SGLT2) inhibitors (empagliflozin, [[SRC:dapagliflozin]], and canagliflozin) have shown a decrease in the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD)
annotation_note: Dapagliflozin được liệt kê rõ trong nhóm SGLT2 inhibitors; đây là bằng chứng cho cạnh Dapagliflozin→SLC5A2 INHIBITS. Không suy từ clinical outcome CKD để tạo thêm cạnh.

evidence_sentence: [[SRC:Canagliflozin]], dapagliflozin and empagliflozin have also been shown to decrease cardiovascular complications and mortality in patients with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease, and to reduce the risk of hospitalization for heart failure and development of end stage renal disease in patients with type 2 diabetes and [[TGT:chronic kidney disease]]
annotation_note: Canagliflozin cùng dapagliflozin/empagliflozin giảm nguy cơ end-stage renal disease ở bệnh nhân T2D và CKD; hỗ trợ bảo vệ tiến triển bệnh thận.

evidence_sentence: To test this hypothesis, we treated SKO mice with the hypoglycemic [[TGT:sodium-glucose cotransporter 2]] (SGLT2) inhibitor [[SRC:dapagliflozin]] and the insulin sensitizer pioglitazone
annotation_note: Dapagliflozin được mô tả là hypoglycemic SGLT2 inhibitor; hỗ trợ cạnh Compound→SLC5A2.

evidence_sentence: Sodium glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors (empagliflozin, canagliflozin, and [[SRC:dapagliflozin]]) have a strong preventive effect on both [[TGT:hospitalization for heart failure]] and the decline in kidney function in patients with type 2 diabetes, while glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists, especially human glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (liraglutide, semaglutide, and albiglutide), suppress arteriosclerotic diseases (stroke and myocardial infarction)
annotation_note: Dapagliflozin nằm trong nhóm SGLT2 inhibitors được mô tả có preventive effect lên hospitalization for HF.

evidence_sentence: BACKGROUND: The sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitor [[SRC:dapagliflozin]] decreases haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), body weight, [[TGT:blood pressure]] (BP) and urinary albumin:creatinine ratio (UACR) in patients with type 2 diabetes
annotation_note: Dapagliflozin được nêu làm giảm blood pressure; đúng chiều Compound→BP. CUSTOM_NODE: BP là phenotype/measurement trong câu evidence; không dùng GO:0003073 (regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure) làm ID cho giá trị blood pressure.

evidence_sentence: The [[SRC:SGLT-2 inhibitors]] have been linked to an increased incidence of genital mycotic infections and, to a lesser extent, [[TGT:urinary tract infections]], which may limit their utility in some patients
annotation_note: SGLT-2 inhibitors được liên kết với increased incidence of UTI; relation adverse event rõ, tuy là association chứ không nên coi là causal proof.
